title: Bound four-factor reuse of signed Type A phase legs
body:
**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7334 and #7113, extend the fixed signed-factor regrouping question to four selected Type A factors. At unit bodies the exact 38-factor relative product at the two legal signs is −I on 36 inputs. Keep unselected factors fixed, transport the four selected factors to the last selected clock, and ask whether three rank-one factors can replace them. Saving one phase leg would have an optimistic gross of about 50.33412118538 raw under the inherited direct-J invoice.

The #7419 proper-window rank equality excludes all four-sets confined to a proper maximal interval. That leaves exactly 2,381 sets crossing both extreme J hosts. The independent integer-minor engine and the denominator-safe modular rank engine agree that each transported displacement has rank four. This closes all 73,815 four-sets in the stated regrouping model. Higher-order regrouping, changed unselected factors and other supplier contracts remain open.

Run python3.12 -I -B research/p104-signed-phase-leg-four-factor-bound/replay.py from a clean POSIX checkout. It binds the exact public #7419 and #7420 receipts, regenerates both checks, and rejects corrupted caller data. Registered, read-only Git-free export and all 27 onboarding checks passed locally. The branch includes two #7257 CI prerequisites.

#7420 supplies the pair/triple factor model, #7419 the proper-window rank and direct-J price, #7334 and #7113 the exact comparator and caller, and #7362 and #7298 directed rank pricing. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.
